generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original Heroes of Might and Magic III hero portrait master, to be reduced to 58x64 and a face crop 48x32 pixels. Subject: Wukong from League of Legends, recognizable brown-furred adult male monkey vastaya, strong simian muzzle and intelligent amber eyes, copper headband, red scarf and broad bronze shoulder armor, tufted reddish brown head hair, confident lively face. Background textured deep blue and warm parchment mountain mist. Close compact head-and-shoulders portrait, entire hair/hat silhouette within frame, face large and readable, three-quarter view. Painterly late-1990s fantasy game portrait, textured hand-painted oil miniature, natural anatomy and individual facial planes, strong warm light from upper left, crisp readable eyes and silhouette, restrained metallic highlights. Original composition, not a copy of a splash painting. No anime, no chibi, no glossy modern key art, no photoreal photograph, no typography, no border, no watermark. One character only, square composition.
